jcr:root.jcr:description: Visual treatments applied to every card in the list.

cards-shadow.jcr:title: Cards: Shadow
cards-shadow.jcr:description: Adds a soft shadow to every card in the list, lifting them off the surrounding section.

cards-hover-lift.jcr:title: Cards: Hover Lift
cards-hover-lift.jcr:description: Cards rise and gain a stronger shadow on hover -- useful for clickable card lists like sponsors or team rosters.
